items.title: OpenAI launches GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol with lower API prices and some benchmark gains
items.summary: OpenAI releases GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol, two new models that are more capable and cheaper than their predecessors. In the independent Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index, Astra ranks second behind Claude Fable 5.2, and it is the first released model to reach the High threshold for AI self-improvement on OpenAI's own scale. items.title: California's attorney general sues OpenAI over rogue AI models that attacked Hugging Face
items.summary: California Attorney General Rob Bonta is suing OpenAI over a cyberattack that the company's out-of-control AI models launched against AI platform Hugging Face in July. The article California's attorney general sues OpenAI over rogue AI models that attacked Hugging Face appeared first on The Decoder .

items.title: OpenAI opens its cybersecurity tool Daybreak to NATO and European governments
items.summary: OpenAI is opening its cybersecurity tool Daybreak to NATO and several European governments, including Germany, France, and Poland. The EU's cybersecurity agency ENISA has already used it to find real vulnerabilities in EU software. The NATO Communications and Information Agency (NCIA) says it's already making heavy use of the underlying models....

items.title: The US wants to block China from renting AI power abroad but China already built a parallel supply chain from US AI output
items.summary: The US is tightening its chip export controls. Data centers in third countries like Singapore and Malaysia will soon need a US license to buy Nvidia chips, closing the loophole that let Chinese firms rent cloud compute abroad. A Reuters investigation also reveals how China offsets its hardware shortage through industrial-scale distillation of US AI models....

items.title: Airbnb Introduces CASTLE for Training Natural Language Search Models with Synthetic Data
items.summary: Airbnb researchers have introduced CASTLE, a framework designed to address the cold-start problem in natural language search. The approach uses de-identified booking sessions and large language models (LLMs) to jointly generate synthetic search queries and relevance labels, enabling model training before sufficient real search traffic is available. By Robert Krzaczyński

items.title: Building trustworthy AI by fencing it in, not predicting it
items.summary: In October this year, OpenAI disclosed that two of its AI agents had switched off the systems built to monitor them. One muted its own safety alerts after misreading an instruction not to send messages; the other removed its monitoring integration during migration, then said it hadn’t. items.title: Uber’s Legal AI Agent Cuts Contract Review Time by 20% with Rules and RAG
items.summary: Uber’s Legal Redlining Agent reviews contract changes in Microsoft Word using RAG, historical lawyer feedback, and deterministic policy rules. Built with LangGraph, OpenSearch, and Redis, the system reports more than 20% lower average contract review time and 91% accuracy in AI-generated decisions. Uber is exploring agentic harnesses, skills, legal ontologies, and knowledge graphs. By Leela Kumili
